summary.business_type: Financial Web Application & Programmatic Tax Utility
top_findings: H1 spacing bug concatenates words into malformed tokens (e.g. 'Reverse Sales TaxCalculator', 'CaliforniaReverse SalesTax Calculator')
Title tag branding duplication and truncation across homepage and all 81 subpages (80-93 chars vs 60 char limit)
Redirect chain on www HTTP traffic: http://www -> https://www (308) -> https://root (301)
Zero indexable tags across entire site, forfeiting all Google Image Search traffic and visual search pack rankings
Missing x-default hreflang tag and asymmetrical international tags between root and subpages
YMYL E-E-A-T gaps: free @gmail.com contact address and absence of credentialed tax expert/CPA review credentials
quick_wins: Fix H1 DOM text spacing in Next.js header component to separate state names and 'Reverse Sales Tax Calculator'
Shorten homepage and state title tags to 50-60 characters, removing the duplicate brand suffix
Trim meta descriptions to under 155 characters to eliminate SERP snippet truncation
Fix UTF-8 character encoding corruption in llms-full.txt
Update contact email to a custom domain address (@salestaxreversecalculator.com) and add CPA review disclaimer

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Full Server-Side Rendering (SSR/SSG) with 7,600+ words in raw HTML — zero rendering lag for Googlebot
Valid XML sitemap with 81 clean URLs and lastmod timestamps
Clean robots.txt explicitly permitting AI search bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot)
Enterprise-grade security headers: HSTS preload, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
Vercel Edge CDN delivery with global HIT caching and clean HTTP 404 error handling

findings.title: Redirect Chain on HTTP WWW Traffic
findings.description: Requests to http://www.salestaxreversecalculator.com experience a 2-hop redirect chain (308 to https://www.salestaxreversecalculator.com/ followed by 301 to https://salestaxreversecalculator.com/).
findings.recommendation: Configure edge DNS/middleware redirect rules to collapse this into a single 301 redirect directly to the canonical HTTPS root.

findings.title: Canonical Tag Trailing Slash Inconsistency
findings.description: The homepage HTML canonical tag specifies 'https://salestaxreversecalculator.com' (without trailing slash), while server response headers and sitemap declare 'https://salestaxreversecalculator.com/'.
findings.recommendation: Align the canonical href attribute with the root trailing slash standard to ensure 100% uniformity.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.description: Although HSTS, nosniff, and X-Frame-Options are implemented, no Content-Security-Policy header is served.
findings.recommendation: Define a robust Content-Security-Policy header restricting script execution and object sources.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Logical breadcrumb hierarchies on inner pages
Clear value proposition and interactive calculator front-and-center
Extensive FAQ section addressing user intent and long-tail queries

findings.title: H1 Heading Spacing & Concatenation Bug
findings.description: Due to missing whitespace around inline spans or line-breaks, heading text renders as 'Reverse Sales TaxCalculator' and 'CaliforniaReverse SalesTax Calculator' in the accessibility tree and DOM.
findings.recommendation: Add a space or proper block-level layout separation in the H1 React component so words are separated by whitespace.

findings.title: Title Tag Brand Duplication & Length Truncation
findings.description: Homepage title is 89 characters ('Reverse Sales Tax Calculator: Find Your Pre-Tax Price Free | Reverse Sales Tax Calculator'). State pages range from 82 to 93 characters. All exceed Google's ~600px / 55-60 character desktop and mobile display limits.
findings.recommendation: Truncate titles to 52-58 characters and remove duplicate brand suffixes. E.g., 'Reverse Sales Tax Calculator: Find Pre-Tax Price Free' (52 chars).

findings.title: Meta Description Truncation
findings.description: Homepage meta description is 172 characters and Texas is 180 characters. Both exceed the 155-160 character limit, cutting off key CTAs with ellipses in SERP snippets.
findings.recommendation: Condense all meta descriptions to 145-155 characters with a clear action verb.

findings.title: Semantic Header Hierarchy Dilution from Sidebar & Footer Widgets
findings.description: Widgets and navigation blocks use H2 and H3 tags ('Embed Reverse Tax Calculator on your site.', 'Popular States', 'Calculators', 'Legal') that disrupt semantic outline before the main content.
findings.recommendation:
Convert secondary sidebar headers and footer navigation labels to styled paragraphs (

) or landmark navigation elements.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: In-depth 7,650-word homepage guide with zero detected AI filler phrases and 1.0 information density
Clear step-by-step mathematical breakdown of the division formula vs the subtracting error
Authoritative outbound citations to the IRS, Tax Foundation, CRA, and OECD on homepage

findings.title: YMYL Financial Authority & Contact Verification Gaps
findings.description: Financial calculations are classified as YMYL. The site uses a generic Gmail address (salestaxreversecalculator@gmail.com) and lacks an identified author with credentials (CPA, enrolled agent, or tax attorney).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade contact email to @salestaxreversecalculator.com, add an 'Editorial & Tax Review Policy', and include author/reviewer bios with tax/accounting credentials.

findings.title: Boilerplate State Pages & Missing Official Revenue Citations
findings.description: The 50 state pages rely on repetitive templates (500-1,000 words) and fail to link to official state Departments of Revenue (e.g. CDTFA for California, Comptroller for Texas).
findings.recommendation: Add official state revenue links, unique district/county threshold notes, and state exemption guides to each state page.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Multi-schema architecture implementing WebSite, WebApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, and BreadcrumbList
Clean JSON-LD with areaServed state targeting on US pages
Valid HowTo markup on /how-it-works page

findings.title: Redundant Single-Item Breadcrumb on Homepage
findings.description: Homepage outputs a BreadcrumbList containing only 1 item. Google guidelines suggest breadcrumbs should indicate depth (2+ levels).
findings.recommendation: Remove BreadcrumbList schema from the root homepage while preserving it on subpages.

findings.title: Missing WebApplication Schema Enhancements
findings.description: WebApplication schema lacks softwareVersion, applicationSubCategory ('Finance/Taxation'), and aggregateRating.
findings.recommendation: Enrich WebApplication schema with applicationSubCategory and softwareVersion properties.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Preloaded WOFF2 modern variable fonts
Fast server response times and edge CDN distribution
Zero blocking third-party ad networks or tracking scripts

findings.title: Heavy Raw HTML Payload via RSC Serialization (288 KB)
findings.description: Raw HTML size is 288 KB, of which 122 KB is serialized React Server Component hydration scripts, causing elevated cellular data consumption on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Optimize static vs dynamic component boundaries in Next.js to minimize hydration payload on static informational pages.

findings.title: Missing Speculation Rules for Instant Client Transitions
findings.description: No <script type='speculationrules'> is implemented for prefetching popular state calculators on hover.
findings.recommendation: Implement speculative prefetching for top linked states (California, Texas, New York, Florida) to achieve instant sub-100ms page transitions.

categories.name: Images & Visual SEO
what_works: Lightweight vector SVG icons for calculator controls
Dynamic Open Graph social card generator (/api/og)

findings.title: Zero Indexable Content Images Across Entire Site
findings.description: Every page on the site has zero tags. The website completely foregoes all Google Image Search traffic and visual search carousels.
findings.recommendation: Create and embed high-resolution infographics and charts (e.g. 'US Sales Tax Rates by State Map 2026', 'Reverse Tax Formula Diagram') in WebP format with descriptive alt text.

findings.title: Open Graph Image URL Discrepancy
findings.description: Schema.org points to /og-image.png while Open Graph meta tags point to dynamic /api/og endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Ensure both point to canonical pre-rendered PNG/WebP assets to ensure reliable social previews across LinkedIn, Slack, and X.

categories.name: AI Search & GEO Readiness
what_works: llms.txt and llms-full.txt implemented and returning 200 OK
Explicitly permits all major AI crawler bots in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
Zero client-side JS dependency for text extraction (7,646 words fully visible in raw SSR HTML)

findings.title: Character Encoding Corruption in llms-full.txt
findings.description: llms-full.txt contains an unencoded replacement character () in its primary header line.
findings.recommendation: Fix the file encoding to UTF-8 and replace the corrupt dash with a standard hyphen or em-dash.

findings.title: Missing Machine-Actionable Tool Definition (WebMCP)
findings.description: Autonomous agents reading the site cannot programmatically trigger a calculation via standard WebMCP or OpenAPI endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Expose a simple JSON calculation endpoint (e.g. /api/calc?total=100&rate=8.25) and document it in llms.txt.

Shorten homepage and top state title tags to under 60 characters and remove duplicate brand suffixes
Eliminate 2-hop redirect chain on HTTP WWW traffic at Vercel/DNS level
Add x-default hreflang tag to homepage

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact On-Page & E-E-A-T
items: Upgrade contact email to @salestaxreversecalculator.com and add CPA review disclaimer
Trim all meta descriptions across 81 pages to 145-155 characters
Demote sidebar and footer widget headers from H2/H3 to styled divs/paragraphs
Add outbound authoritative links to state revenue departments on all 50 state pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Visual SEO & Image Asset Strategy
items: Design and publish 'US Sales Tax Rates 2026 Map' and 'Reverse Tax Formula Diagram'
Implement WebP images with responsive srcset, width/height, and descriptive alt text
Add state-to-state contextual navigation grid on state subpages

items: Implement Speculation Rules API for instant prefetching of calculators on user hover
Optimize Next.js RSC hydration payload to reduce HTML weight below 150 KB
Add OpenAPI / JSON calculation endpoint for agentic citation in llms.txt
